text:
Stop waiting for the perfect plan. It's killing you.

It's 2 a.m. You have a notebook full of ideas you never started. You tell yourself you need more time. That's the someday story.

One man had one idea and no backup plan. He walked into the room and refused to leave until it worked.

Years later it paid off.

The perfect plan keeps you broke. Your one idea starts tonight.
caption:
The mindset that builds real success habits isn't waiting for the perfect plan. Discipline means one idea, all the way.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#discipline #selfimprovement #mindset #successhabits #men
